title: Monday Morning Quarterback
date_line: Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. College Thursday night review: UTSA at Florida Atlantic and James Madison at Southern Miss (Nov. 5), graded. Then the rest of the college week.

paragraphs: Thursday night put two games on the board, and neither one stayed close to the number once the second half got going. Southern Miss +13.5 was covering at the half in Hattiesburg, still covering by half a point after three quarters, and then James Madison ran away and the dog tickets burned. Florida Atlantic +7 never needed a sweat in Boca Raton, and the Under 72.5 was already cooked by halftime in a 89-point track meet. James Madison covered 13.5 by 17.5 and the Over 58.5 cleared it by 18.5. Florida Atlantic covered 7 by 38 and the Under went over by 16.5.

Every game below is graded against the line printed on the card at kickoff, using ESPN finals and play-by-play, and a push counts as neither a hit nor a miss. The UTSA at Florida Atlantic card opened Florida Atlantic +7 with a total of 72.5 and stayed there through the evening refreshes, with the Cover Writer on Florida Atlantic +7 and the Under, projecting UTSA 38, Florida Atlantic 32. Follow The Money never got a consensus side or total it liked, so it had no pick on either. The James Madison at Southern Miss card opened Southern Miss +14.5 with 58.5, and the evening refresh moved the side to Southern Miss +13.5 with the total still 58.5. The Cover Writer stayed on Southern Miss +13.5 and the Over, projecting James Madison 36, Southern Miss 23. Next Man Up flipped to James Madison −13.5 with the Over. The Formula stayed on Southern Miss +13.5 and took the Under. Follow The Money liked Southern Miss +13.5 and had no total. The kickoff numbers are what's graded here. Southern Miss +14.5 would have missed by the same 17.5.

In The Trenches saw split run-game reads in both games, so it had no side in either, and had no total in either. Letdown Watch made no picks Thursday. Follow The Money had no side and no total in UTSA vs Florida Atlantic, and no total in James Madison vs Southern Miss. None of those are graded.

Card line: James Madison −13.5, total 58.5. The Cover Writer's card had Southern Miss +13.5 and the Over, projecting James Madison 36, Southern Miss 23. Final: James Madison 54, Southern Miss 23. James Madison won by 31, and the teams scored 77 points.

Southern Miss +13.5 looked like a cash for a long stretch. Suarez opened it with a 32-yard field goal, Evans ran in from 3 yards out, and James Madison led 10-0. White cut it to 10-7 from 3 yards out, Suarez made it 13-7 from 31, and then Robinson punched in from 2 yards out with 37 seconds left in the half for a 14-13 Southern Miss lead. Suarez answered from 40 at the gun, and it was James Madison 16, Southern Miss 14 at the break. Southern Miss +13.5 was covering by 11.5, and the total sat at 30, 28.5 short of the Over 58.5.

The third quarter still belonged to the dog tickets. Evans ran 16 yards for a touchdown and 2 more later, and it was 30-14. Southern Miss +13.5 was still covering by half a point with a quarter to go. The Over sat at 44 and needed 14.5 more.

Then the fourth quarter tore up every Southern Miss +13.5 ticket on the board. Evans found Cromwell for 16 yards and a touchdown at 13:41, and the margin jumped to 23. Southern Miss +13.5 was dead by 9.5 before the next snap. McCarter ran 30 yards for another touchdown at 11:33, and it was 44-14. 58 points, and Over 58.5 tickets were half a point short. White hit Sanders for 34 yards and a touchdown at 9:10, the two-point try failed, and it was 44-20. 64 points, Over 58.5 cashed by 5.5, and the Southern Miss side was already buried. Coleman found Scott for 26 more, Wilbanks hit from 29, Suarez hit from 34, and the final was James Madison 54, Southern Miss 23. Southern Miss +13.5 lost by 17.5 after covering for three quarters. The Over cleared 58.5 by 18.5.
Called it: Next Man Up on James Madison −13.5, covered by 17.5 points. The Cover Writer and Next Man Up on the Over 58.5, cleared it by 18.5 points.
Missed: The Cover Writer, The Formula and Follow The Money on Southern Miss +13.5, missed by 17.5 points. The Formula on the Under 58.5, went over by 18.5 points.
No pick: Follow The Money on the total; In The Trenches on the side or the total.

items.matchup: College Thursday · No sweat against the number

paragraphs: Card line: UTSA −7, total 72.5. The Cover Writer's card had Florida Atlantic +7 and the Under, projecting UTSA 38, Florida Atlantic 32. Final: UTSA 29, Florida Atlantic 60. Florida Atlantic won by 31, and the teams scored 89 points.

Florida Atlantic +7 never needed a sweat. Veltkamp hit Messer from 6 yards out for a 7-0 lead, McCown answered with Anderson from 20, then Messer threw a 14-yard touchdown to Johnson and Veltkamp hit Messer again from 15, and Florida Atlantic led 21-7 after one. Florida Atlantic +7 was already covering by 21.

The first half kept pouring it on. Peterson ran 52 yards for a touchdown, and the kick failed. Johnson ran in from 4. Anderson caught one from 45, and the two-point try failed. Farrow caught an 18-yard touchdown with 50 seconds left in the half, Petro hit a 54-yard field goal at the gun, and it was Florida Atlantic 35, UTSA 22 at the break. 57 points already, and Under 72.5 tickets needed the second half to stay under 15.5 combined. Florida Atlantic +7 was covering by 20.

The second half finished both tickets. Johnson ran in from 4 again, and the two-point try made it 43-22. McCown found Butler-Tanner from 26, then Farrow ripped off a 59-yard touchdown run, and it was 50-29. Rogers had a 28-yard field goal blocked, and Veltkamp hit Messer from 6 on the next snap anyway. Tennison got sacked, fumbled, and Florida Atlantic recovered. Grace hit from 37, and the final was Florida Atlantic 60, UTSA 29. Florida Atlantic +7 cashed by 38. The Under went over by 16.5, and the second half alone scored 32.
Called it: The Cover Writer and Next Man Up on Florida Atlantic +7, covered by 38 points. Next Man Up on the Over 72.5, cleared it by 16.5 points.
Missed: The Formula on UTSA −7, missed by 38 points. The Cover Writer and The Formula on the Under 72.5, went over by 16.5 points.
No pick: Follow The Money on the side or the total; In The Trenches on the side or the total.

hits.heading: Part 1, continued: The week's W-L and smack talk

paragraphs: The Cover Writer went 1-1 against the spread and 1-1 on totals Thursday, and that makes the week 3-4 on both. Florida Atlantic +7 was a cruise, and the Over 58.5 cashed once James Madison pulled away. Southern Miss +13.5 died in the fourth after covering for three quarters, and the Under 72.5 was finished by halftime.

The Formula went 0-2 on sides and 0-2 on totals Thursday, 3-4 and 2-5 for the week. Both Under tickets went over, UTSA −7 got run out of Boca Raton, and Southern Miss +13.5 took the same fourth-quarter beating the Cover Writer took. The Formula owned the side lead for the week after Wednesday. Thursday wiped it out.

Next Man Up went 2-0 on sides and 2-0 on totals Thursday, 4-3 and 4-3 for the week. Florida Atlantic +7 and James Madison −13.5 both covered by double digits, and both Overs cleared. Two nights ago Next Man Up was tied with the Cover Writer ticket for ticket. Thursday it left the Cover Writer in the dust.

Follow The Money went 0-1 on sides and made no total picks Thursday, 2-1 and 2-2 for the week. Southern Miss +13.5 was the only ticket it put down, and the fourth quarter punched it out. Follow The Money still has no side loss from Tuesday or Wednesday, and Thursday is the first one.
In The Trenches made no picks Thursday, and it is 4-0 on sides for the week. Split trench reads kept it off both boards. No side loss, and no new wins either.
Letdown Watch made no picks Thursday, Wednesday or Tuesday.
